items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about John Nesbitt? Do you remember him as . . . [INTERVIEWEE] Did he do anything for Fletcher Henderson?

ctx.x: I don’t know how much he did for him. There were some other people. There was Joe Glover, who . . . gee, I don’t remember all of them, but there were some other arrangers.
What about John Nesbitt? Do you remember him as . . .
Did he do anything for Fletcher Henderson?

items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I would feel that Gene Gifford might have been influenced somewhat by John Nesbitt, who arranged for McKinney's Cotton Pickers.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Now just in general, how could you describe their style in general? Or something

Gene Gifford. I think Gene Gifford did a thing called 'White Heat' -- would that sound right? 'White Heat' for the Goldkette band. A couple of things he did were kind of ... his arrangements, if I remember, I would feel that Gene Gifford might have been influenced somewhat by John Nesbitt, who arranged for McKinney's Cotton Pickers.
